candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.greeting: Dear Sartorius R&D Innovation Synergies team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student Data Science position in your R&D Innovation Synergies team. Building the data foundations that let scientists trust and use their data is work I have done in industry, and doing it for life science R&D, where it helps bring therapies to patients faster, is a strong motivation for me.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I designed and implemented SAP Datasphere data pipelines and rebuilt a client's datasets end to end during a 42-dashboard migration from SAP BW
I built data models from ABAP CDS view sources and joins for reporting, and validated and reconciled data to keep it accurate
I built a PyTorch medical image classifier for retinal OCT scans that reached 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set, including all preprocessing and augmentation

letter.problems_section: In your team I would help build and maintain pipelines and data models, prepare and clean data for the Data Science and Innovation team, and pick up short-notice and administrative tasks reliably. I work with Python, Pandas and scikit-learn and am keen to learn the cloud and analytical tools you use.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for 20 hours per week and am open to Göttingen, Bielefeld or Ulm. I would be glad to discuss how I can support your team.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
